craft_notes: Low camera, warm car against snowy forest and large dark threat. The diagonal car angle and readable wheel silhouettes carry movement. Use purposeful environmental contrast.
Avatar and accessories fill the left, with parallel lines and an icon anchoring the right. Sharp blocks of complementary colour keep a sparse layout intentional.
Small avatar beside a large shark and clean blocks of sky/grass. An explicit action panel overlaps the upper corner. Only use interface callouts when they match the featured mechanic.
Tsunami arcs around a foreground rider and echoes motion. Scale and contrasting yellow foreground help the player read immediately.
Diagonal battle split gives equal weight to two portraits. Place high contrast at the action line and keep figures separately readable.
Game-like rig in a plain daylight environment. Effects show force without hiding the figure. Use crisp block parts and clean material values.
Leaping player, goal line, ball and defender stage a single shot. Bright sky silhouettes the ball and limbs at smaller sizes.
Overhead lens enlarges the foreground ball while pitch markings anchor depth. Keep faces secondary when defining action through trajectories.
Foreground avatar carries a physical tree in front of a retail lot. The object and destination explain the verb. Seasonal tree-lot signage belongs to this game.
Rear three-quarter character lifts their hand to a door. Warm doorway lamps and the arm position sell the beat without a caption.
Dark earth surrounds a precisely pointed tool. Two fists occupy the lower corners and the small impact point stays centred.
Blocky player crouches with the weapon along cover. Matte surfaces and directional daylight keep the weapon and face readable.
Large yellow character interacts with the lunar surface in a spare blue-black scene. Preserve separation between the gag and an optional interaction prompt.
One alarmed figure in the foreground and a distant figure in the corridor. Stage the reveal with depth and a clear receding sightline.
Wave and excavator fill opposite sides with a clear survival deadline. Thick silhouettes and navy versus yellow make the conflict legible.
Damaged cars and smoke form a low foreground group. Perspective and debris carry the impact. Avoid copying the source vehicle or marque.
Classic blocky character pinned beneath an oversized industrial press. Gray materials preserve readable values and hazard stripes show the mechanism.
A mostly dark forest gives the threat room to emerge. Keep enough local contrast for some shape to survive a reduced preview.
Large creature framed behind a near-lens white avatar. Warm simple desert and blue sky make size and danger easy to read.
Flight deck console and pilot establish a credible cockpit. Exterior gameplay is framed through the windshield rather than covering the interior.
Hands and scissors frame hair against open sky. Correct grasp and blade position make the action legible even with the caption removed.
A foreground reaction and dark pursuer prove a shared physical space. Keep the two faces in different values and use hard architecture edges as anchors.
Pool edge, grasping figure and large threat establish the escape line. Maintain hand-to-wall contact and coherent water reflection.
Hands hold a hammer into a simple framing scene. Large geometric materials make the tool task understandable without text.
One avatar divided along a clear transformation axis. Shape and reserved glow on the upgraded side sell the contrast. Use only truthful levels when requested.
Oversized foreground chaser in a simple environment, with the smaller target separated by colour and depth. Read the relationship before adding impacts or particles.
Diagonal before/after cut contrasts one modest plot with a developed farm. Retain the same mechanic on both sides and make changes visually explicit.
Several bright action scenes show oversized hazards and isolated avatars. Use the board to compare hooks, then use a single-scene reference for final framing.
Four tiles contrast obby motion, menu-like framing and action. Compare treatment across tiles and take only the relevant visual cues.
Bright stud worlds with clean, high-key renders and one dominant action object per tile. Use for contrast and colour, with a single image for composition.
A close cropped blocky tower defender and its weapon dominate. Red backlight separates the silhouette from the cool uniform. Keep the weapon direction and wrist alignment credible.
Bright cyan crate mass commands the left, with dark figures and a restrained teal atmosphere behind. Place the brightest edge on the actual reward and keep background highlights lower.
A blocky foreground fighter anchors a larger gold-edged antagonist. Use exposure and scale to separate the two silhouettes without flooding both with glow.
Two flank silhouettes and purple lightning frame the central encounter. Leave negative space around the character and shape the effects around the action.
Dark eclipse and thin purple rim establish the backdrop. A small number of hot orange accents define the mechanical threat and foreground stakes.

Low road-level view. The red car dominates the lower foreground, road texture sells speed, and the helicopter is a distant story beat. Preserve clear vehicle outlines and a believable vanishing point.
One small avatar on a foreground ridge against layered blue-green forest. Distance, terrain perspective and lighter background values sell scale. Use for an environment-led brief.
Three-quarter view of the lead car, with rocky desert and trailing action separated in depth. Keep wheel contact and suspension stance plausible.
Two human-sized blocky characters and an oversized red threat in an outdoor set. Let avatar silhouettes, scene light and scale tell the story.
A close crouched hero behind clean geometric cover. Eye line and opposing movement define the action. Background is big, simple geometry.
A warm campfire illuminates blocky faces in a cool night setting. Stage the relationship in a small grouping and make light falloff believable.
Close-to-black environment with a small bright light source and vertical shapes. Use a deliberately scarce accent and preserve silhouette clearance.
Two avatars separated by distance and trajectory. The architecture gives jump direction. Ignore the logo treatment unless explicitly requested.
Large colourful pets contrast against a soft pastel crowd. Keep one dominant collectible, simplify background companions and preserve action contact.
Boat, upright characters and fishing action form one focal group. Bright water gives silhouettes clean contrast. Keep title area optional.
Foreground blocky figure, exaggerated prop and strongly lit town scene. Keep scale exaggeration legible and avoid importing event copy.
Close foreground helmet on one side and a thin threat down a corridor. Surveillance framing is a deliberate hook. Borrow sightline and lighting without the timecode or watermark.
Low camera and close hand on a bar immediately show climbing. Keep believable fingers or block hands, bar contact and a clear next route.
Steps converge behind a single runner against a mostly open cyan sky. One prop path, clean contact and simple background make the route legible.
Car silhouette, night street, wet reflections and a small bright skyline. Use directional reflections that agree with scene sources.
Foreground avatar separated by warm storefront lighting. Character spacing and prop scale sell the social scene. Leave out the title unless requested.
Ball, athlete and court markings make one sports verb legible. Use low perspective and accurate prop scale.
Crisp near-lens object and distant scenery frame a secondary blocky character. Direct the key light to maintain depth rather than adding colour to every surface.
Foreground movement toward camera plus brightly lit blocky environments. Use a readable pose, clean material bands and small expressive groups.
Cool blue tunnel frames a sharp foreground figure with smaller secondary characters. Let architecture and receding lights establish direction.
Steep diagonal shows a slipping player against a clean hazard boundary. Clear contact and enough runway convey what can happen next.
One hero car in a low three-quarter view. Controlled reflections and magenta blossom backdrop. Borrow the separation and stance without branding or artist watermark.
Saturated green setting, a large central progression cue and clustered valuables. Use the one-step visual hierarchy, with any copy and numbers tied to the actual game.
Giant golden opponent and foreground fighters, with a side panel for a weapon comparison. Use this split only for a requested upgrade or contrast hook.
Two foreground hands draw focus to cards, with shallow background and a purple highlight. Keep grasp and orientation plausible.
Oversized back-lit character and smaller summoners create immediate scale. Existing caption is source-specific. Use edge separation rather than cloning the text or halo shape.
Shadowed blocky figure and distant threat share a mostly dark environment. Use selective readability without copying the arrows or callout graphics.
A plane wing and grounded avatar give scale. The largely cool scene lets one uniform colour serve as the accent.
